# Filter Error Code

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

With codes = \[41, 43\], error_in = {"status": true, "code": 41, "source": "&lt;3&gt;{\"desc\":\"sensor unplugged\",\"loc\":\"read-sensor\"}"}, Run displays codes_cleared = \[41\], error_cleared = true, error_out = {"status": false, "code": 0, "source": ""}.
